title: Rustic Spaghetti Salad
description: This easy-to-make rustic spaghetti pasta salad recipe features spaghetti and anchovies with lemon juice, balsamic vinegar, garlic, and black pepper.
ingredients: 6 tablespoons olive oil, or more to taste
0.25 teaspoon minced garlic, or to taste
1 pinch red pepper flakes, or to taste
1 pinch ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in boiling water until tender yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes; drain. Transfer spaghetti to a large bowl.

Drizzle spaghetti with olive oil; toss to coat. Add anchovy fillets, garlic, balsamic vinegar, lemon juice, pepper flakes, and black pepper; mix well. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap; refrigerate until chilled, about 30 minutes.
